plan: This mechanism is equivalent to a second-price auction: my sealed bid acts as my maximum willingness to pay, and I only pay the second-highest bid if I win. In such auctions, truthful bidding (bidding exactly my value) is the dominant strategy—it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' bids. Bidding higher risks paying more than my value; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With no prior history to suggest otherwise, I'll bid my true value of $13.
